verdicts.reason: The report template defines the heading "## Convergence Findings" for the round report.
The same "## Convergence Findings" template applies to `convergence-2.md` in round 2.
`convergence.md` is the file "in round 1" and the template field is "**Round**: 1 | 2", so round 1 must say 1.
`convergence-2.md` is the file "in round 2", so the "**Round**: 1 | 2" field must say 2.
The template sets "**Outcome**: converged | tasks_appended" as the allowed values.
The same "**Outcome**: converged | tasks_appended" enum applies to the round-2 report.
The template gives the findings table columns "| ID | Gap Type | Severity | Source | Evidence | Remaining Work |".
The same findings table template applies to the round-2 report.
"If there are one or more actionable findings (`tasks_appended` outcome): ... Append to the **end** of `tasks.md`" directly requires the append under that condition.
"Append to the **end** of `tasks.md`, per the append contract" requires append-only writes during converge.
The same append contract ("Append to the **end** of `tasks.md`") governs the round-2 converge window.
"Determine the next phase number `N` (highest existing phase + 1)" is an explicit numbering requirement.
"Write a single new section header `## Phase N: Convergence`" directly sets the header format.
The cited line "Emit one checklist item per actionable finding" is about checklist items in `tasks.md`, so it only implicitly supports consistency between Outcome and findings rows in the report.
"Emit one checklist item per actionable finding" is about tasks, so it supports the round-2 outcome/rows check only indirectly.
"`<gap-type>` is one of `missing`, `partial`, `contradicts`, `unrequested`" defines the allowed values for convergence task lines.
"Never reuse or renumber existing IDs" is an absolute prohibition and supports a must.
"If a prior Convergence phase exists, add a new, separately-numbered one below it" directly supports the round-2 phase check.
"do not touch the old one" requires append-only behavior in round 2.
"Write as the round report's last line: **'✅ Converged — ...'**" is an explicit requirement for the converged report (this assumes the rule only checks it when Outcome is converged).
